|lore=The alcoves of Jabba’s palace are good places to make deals and place bets. Jabba gets a cut of the profits, of course.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Your unique (•) aliens are forfeit +2. Your unique (•) non-smuggler aliens whose printed deploy costs are greater than or equal to their printed forfeit are deploy -2 and forfeit +1. Once per turn, you may ▼ Attark, Crell, Ghoel, Laudica, Leslomy, Loje, or Vul (for free if to a Jabba’s Palace site). (Immune to Alter.)
|errata_history=Versions of [[Bargaining Table (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 1, slip 4 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “Deploy on table. Your unique (•) aliens are forfeit +2. Your unique (•) non-smuggler aliens whose printed deploy costs are greater than or equal to their printed forfeit are deploy -2 and forfeit +1. Once per turn, you may ▼ Attark, Crell, Ghoel, Laudica, Leslomy, Loje, or Vul (for free if to a Jabba’s Palace site). A” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•4” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bargaining Table (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 4), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. Your unique (•) aliens are forfeit +1. Your unique (•) aliens with printed deploy costs greater than or equal to printed forfeit are deploy -1 and forfeit +1. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Attark, Crell, Ghoel, Laudica, Leslomy, Loje, or Vul from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
